newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat backpedals to close lower.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat backpedals to close lower.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures backpedaled off their recent highs on a lack of scale-down buying and on spillover pressure from CBOT and KCBT wheat, traders said.
KCBT and CBOT wheat sagged on uncertainty about the extent of freeze damage to the hard red winter wheat crop.

"We rallied 60 cents in Minneapolis over the past two weeks, but since yesterday we've lost 15 or 20 cents. It's like we're in freefall. You'll probably see more followthrough to the downside tomorrow until we find support," a MGE trader said after the close.

Traders said a combination of light-volume selling and technical sell-stops applied heavy pressure to spring wheat toward the close. In particular, December spring wheat lost three cents a bushel in the closing 10 minutes of trade.
MGE spring wheat settled five to 10 cents per bushel lower, with May down 9-1/4 cents at $4.35-3/4. New crop September was down 9-1/2 cents at $4.31.
